Actually, deleting requires a call. Let me just delete it via DELETE endpoint.

Wait—but the DB was empty (fresh migration). Adding test data and deleting is fine. Let me delete.

Also test authorization: does a token without app-access get 403? Not necessary.

Let me clean up and finalize.
